answer: Sybil resistance can rest on routing depth, not fees. A new key must settle a seeded payment back to itself through five independent relays, each forwarding only value it already holds in a funded channel. The registry weights the key by its minimum hop depth: minting a thousand accounts means persuading a thousand unrelated partners to lock capital behind them, and shared sponsors surface as a ripple across the cohort ledger. A falcon sweep discounts depth credit where one counterparty backs too many newcomers, making a sable flock of look-alikes cost more than its payouts return.
